$comment: The macro catalogue for headers, footers and Bates numbering (M53). Data, not code: PLAN.md §4.4. `token` is what the reader types or inserts from the menu; `type` is what the expander in src/engine/decorations/macros.ts recognises. A token whose type this build does not know is left on the page as written rather than guessed at, so adding one here without the code is visible rather than silent. Date and time use the explicit pattern in `<<d:...>>`; the patterns are the usual d/dd/M/MM/MMM/MMMM/yy/yyyy/HH/mm/ss and are formatted in English so a file made on one machine reads the same on another.

macros.label: Page number
macros.description: 1, 2, 3 — the position in the range this decoration covers.

macros.label: Page number of total
macros.description: "7 of 100" — the position and how many pages there are.

macros.label: Number of pages
macros.description: How many pages the range covers.

macros.label: Page label
macros.description: The page's own label, when the document numbers its pages itself (i, ii, A-5).

macros.label: Bates number
macros.description: The Bates number of this page, when the document is Bates-numbered.

macros.label: File name
macros.description: The document's file name, without its folder.

macros.label: Full path
macros.description: The document's whole path on this computer.

macros.label: Title
macros.description: The document's title from its properties.

macros.label: Author
macros.description: The document's author from its properties.

macros.label: Subject
macros.description: The document's subject from its properties.

macros.label: Time
macros.description: The time the decoration was added, as HH:mm.

macros.label: Date, your pattern
macros.description: A date written the way you spell it. Put the pattern after d: — d, dd, M, MM, MMM, MMMM, yy, yyyy, HH, mm, ss.
